subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) MP-KO 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adb15020a62c24dffe892132f7bc40e37b656fb109e26715b6373aaf3c616ef7.png] 

Option 2) PS-NR 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56d6b8cf889f25f4b7f12ed744c775165cdcb8bdb380833c001c3257c995b47a.png] 

Option 3) UX-SW 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab1acdf5423abc4301033cd2147542696d5ef645cca98b9c6cae12e9a299f64e.png] 

**Option 4) RU-PS **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ff55b4b542e0dfdb351d17a39853f96872b321bd59262c1f78e941a964a25e.png] 

Here, 'RU-PS' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
